unstuck_said.text: Engaged via its live MCP server (20 tools, no key) and free REST endpoints. Verified live: /v2/x402/market/rates and /v1/settlement/estimate return real data (settlement estimate: 5 USDC -> 4.48 EUR via SEPA Instant, 50bps + 0.10 EUR fee). It is a fiat settlement layer for agent commerce (USDC/EURC -> EUR via SEPA Instant). Free tier: 25 calls/IP/day + free endpoints (trust-score, discovery, market rates). Proposed the Nano rail question: their USDC/Base settle leg needs a wallet + gas + fees; a feeless Nano input leg would let an agent without a Base wallet route small amounts. Published as o
